The game in `/workspace/game` has been rewritten in place into **ExpLit** telling **"Alice's Adventures in Wonderland"** (`CHAPTER I. Down the Rabbit-Hole`, chapter `c01` only), following `/workspace/CONTRACT.md`:

- **Title Screen, Naming & Scope**: Updated `index.html`, `client/index.html`, `package.json`, `README.md`, `NOTICE`, and client/server scripts so the page `<title>` and title screen display **ExpLit** with **Alice's Adventures in Wonderland** below it and zero references to the original game's name outside `NOTICE` and vendored files.
- **Chapter 1 Zone, Cast & Beats**: Configured `client/js/storydata.js`, `client/js/localgameclient.js`, `client/js/game.js`, `client/js/items.js`, `client/js/mobs.js`, and `client/js/npcs.js` so only the Chapter 1 cast (`alice`, `sister`, `white_rabbit`), items (`pocket_watch`, `golden_key`, `drink_me_bottle`), and beats (`c01_b01`–`c01_b07`) exist in the zone. Completing the chapter goal shows the completion banner and advances to the **"To be continued"** screen for `CHAPTER II. The Pool of Tears`.
- **Assets, Synthetic Slots & Style Palette**: Removed all 257 unkept/replaced upstream image and audio files, wired `client/js/sprite.js` and `client/js/audio.js` to `/workspace/assets/manifest.json` and `/workspace/assets/audio_manifest.json` (`assets/...`), added `dialogue_portrait` and `chapter_backdrop` synthetic slots, and applied `/workspace/style.json` palette colors (`#F6F0E0`, `#8DA387`, `#57838C`, `#C88285`, `#D9A74A`, `#233142`, `#D8CFB8`) and `material_sprite_effects` (`#C88285`).
- **Accessibility, Controls & Playtest/Session Hooks**: Styled `#explit-subtitle-text` with `'Atkinson Hyperlegible', Verdana, sans-serif` at `28px` (`#233142` on `#F6F0E0`, `letter-spacing: 0.05em`, `line-height: 1.6`, max 2 lines), added `O` / hold `Space` / `Shift` toggling and 2-line paging for `original` book passages, added keyboard controls with `#explit-keyboard-hint`, exposed `window.playtest`, wired `localStorage['storyworld.session']` and `#download-session-link`, and wrote `/workspace/CHECKS.md`.
